summary: Iter 8 completed for backend+frontend scope. Backend pytest for payment-history/activity/plan visibility passed 10/11 with one critical auth-data failure: seeded Admin (9999999998) logs in as subscriber role. Verified subscriber live plan refresh works without navigation (~10-20s polling), payment-history auth/filter/pagination/dedupe behavior works, and activity version updates on complaint status change. Frontend mobile run was partially completed; key subscriber and super-admin flows passed until modal close interaction blocked by viewport/overlay in web preview.

critical.issue: Seeded Admin account returns role 'subscriber' instead of 'admin'. This breaks role-based admin dashboard/payment queue access.

ui_bugs.issue: `cancel-pay` was not tappable in 390x844 web preview after opening payment sheet (element outside viewport).

integration_issues.issue: Admin seeded phone 9999999998 did not reach admin overview because backend returned subscriber role.

issues: No horizontal overflow observed in tested screens at 390x844.

action_items: Fix seeded-role integrity for 9999999998 (admin) and ensure role restoration strategy when one seeded account is missing.
Investigate why seeded admin record became subscriber; guard against accidental role drift in OTP signup path.
Fix recharge modal close usability at 390x844 (`cancel-pay` should remain tappable without extra scroll).
After fixes, rerun full 4-role UI suite including admin read-only checks and team/subscriber activity alert isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: Seed logic in server.py seeds only when users collection is empty (`if count_documents({}) > 0: return`). If one seeded account is deleted/corrupted, it is never repaired on restart. This explains admin role drift persisting.
Auth verify path auto-creates missing users as subscriber (`verify_otp`), so any missing seeded admin phone can reappear as subscriber unless protected.
payment_activity.py correctly escapes search input (`re.escape`) and union-dedupes approved screenshot payments using receipt lookup; validated by iter8 tests.
Activity alert backend returns team complaints only and excludes payment items for team role as expected; validated.
Frontend uses `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` in src/api.ts. Ensure this remains aligned with deployment/env policy to avoid config drift.

success_rate.frontend: Partial (~55%) due early stop after repeated modal interaction failure and downstream role impact

seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST subscribers (7-prefixed) and generated cash/free/upi payment records via assign-plan + screenshot approval for iter8 backend validations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI testing was intentionally stopped after repeated failures around the same interaction area (loop-prevention). Resume from subscriber recharge modal close behavior and rerun seeded-role logins once admin role is fixed.
rca_of_issue: Repro: POST /api/auth/verify-otp with phone 9999999998 returns user.role=subscriber. Expected admin. Likely cause: seeded admin record was missing/corrupted earlier; verify_otp auto-creates unknown numbers as subscriber, and seed() does not repair partial seed loss because it exits when users collection is non-empty. Mitigation: add protected seeded-account reconciliation on startup or block auto-signup for reserved seeded admin/team/super phones when missing role metadata.
